name: my-smart-terminal
description: Multi-instance desktop terminal with Markdown sessions and Git sync

scripts.dev:electron: wait-on http://127.0.0.1:4200 dist/apps/desktop/main.js dist/apps/desktop/preload.js && cross-env SMART_TERMINAL_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:4200 node scripts/run-electron.mjs apps/desktop
scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
scripts.start: npm run build && node scripts/run-electron.mjs apps/desktop
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && ng build renderer --configuration development
scripts.test:tabs-smoke: npm run build && node scripts/reset-smoke-data.mjs && cross-env SMART_TERMINAL_DATA_REPO=.smoke-data SMART_TERMINAL_TABS_SMOKE=1 node scripts/run-electron.mjs apps/desktop
scripts.test:editor-smoke: npm run build && node scripts/reset-smoke-data.mjs && cross-env SMART_TERMINAL_DATA_REPO=.smoke-data SMART_TERMINAL_EDITOR_SMOKE=1 node scripts/run-electron.mjs apps/desktop
scripts.test:sidebar-smoke: npm run build && node scripts/reset-smoke-data.mjs && cross-env SMART_TERMINAL_DATA_REPO=.smoke-data SMART_TERMINAL_SIDEBAR_SMOKE=1 node scripts/run-electron.mjs apps/desktop
scripts.test:clipboard-smoke: npm run build && node scripts/reset-smoke-data.mjs && cross-env SMART_TERMINAL_DATA_REPO=.smoke-data SMART_TERMINAL_CLIPBOARD_SMOKE=1 node scripts/run-electron.mjs apps/desktop
scripts.test:search-smoke: npm run build && node scripts/reset-smoke-data.mjs && cross-env SMART_TERMINAL_DATA_REPO=.smoke-data SMART_TERMINAL_SEARCH_SMOKE=1 node scripts/run-electron.mjs apps/desktop
scripts.test:sync-ui-smoke: npm run build && node scripts/reset-smoke-data.mjs && cross-env SMART_TERMINAL_DATA_REPO=.smoke-data SMART_TERMINAL_SYNC_UI_SMOKE=1 node scripts/run-electron.mjs apps/desktop
scripts.test:ipc-smoke: npm run build && node scripts/reset-smoke-data.mjs && cross-env SMART_TERMINAL_DATA_REPO=.smoke-data SMART_TERMINAL_SMOKE=1 node scripts/run-electron.mjs apps/desktop
scripts.test:pty-smoke: npm run rebuild:native && npm run build && node scripts/reset-smoke-data.mjs && cross-env SMART_TERMINAL_DATA_REPO=.smoke-data SMART_TERMINAL_PTY_SMOKE=1 node scripts/run-electron.mjs apps/desktop
scripts.package:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.package:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.package:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.package:dir: npm run build && electron-builder --dir --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
